scope: Two runs of one fixed experiment; not a release verdict

policy.interpretation: Predeclared screening criteria, not a universal guarantee or a software SHIP decision. Human review required even within bounds.
policy.loss_rationale: ln(1.01): at most 1% perplexity ratio for comparable mean NLL. Logged train loss is rounded, so also report exact equality at available resolution.
policy.weight_rationale: 2^-10 is one FP16 spacing near 1, used as a relative L2 screening scale for this T4 FP16-compute experiment, not a bound on error accumulation or FP32 adapter storage. Zero denominators handled explicitly; nonzero differences always reported.
policy.behavior_rationale: Eight held-out examples are too coarse to tolerate one differing output unnoticed (12.5% of the sample); require identical generated token IDs for the screen.
